questions.prompt: Which decade saw the fall of the Soviet Union?
questions.fact: The Soviet Union formally dissolved on 26 December 1991, and fifteen independent states took its place.

questions.prompt: Which planet is known for being the hottest in the solar system?
questions.fact: Venus is hotter than Mercury despite being further from the Sun: a runaway greenhouse effect holds the surface at around 460C.

questions.prompt: How long is a standard marathon?
questions.fact: The odd distance is a leftover from the 1908 London Olympics, when the course was stretched to 26 miles 385 yards so it could finish in front of the royal box.

questions.prompt: Which film features the quote 'I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse'?
questions.fact: Brando was so unwanted by the studio that he had to screen-test for the part. He won the Oscar for it and refused to accept it.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?
questions.fact: Lisbon is older than Rome. A 1755 earthquake destroyed so much of it that the rebuilt centre became one of Europe's first planned earthquake-resistant districts.

questions.prompt: In the Percy Jackson series, which Greek god is Percy's father?
questions.fact: Percy being Poseidon's son is itself the problem: the three eldest gods swore an oath to father no more children, so his existence breaks it.
GPS satellites carry atomic clocks that must be corrected for relativity. Time runs measurably faster in orbit, and ignoring it would throw positions off by miles a day.
